searchText: Can someone please explain to me is https://ethresear.ch/t/executable-beacon-chain/8271 happening for sure? Also is it happening "within the next few weeks" as the block put it realistic? Beacon chain is live. Executable beacon chain is not. Getting executable beacon chain within "the next few weeks" would require a catastrophic emergency and major re-ordering of priorities.
